title: Fresh Red Chilli Sambal
summary: Fresh red chillies pulsed with rice vinegar, salt and a touch of sugar into a coarse, bright paste, finished with lime.

ingredients.item: fresh long red chillies, stems removed, roughly chopped
fine sea salt or table salt
lime juice, plus wedges to serve

steps.title: Prepare the chillies
steps.text: Put on gloves and roughly chop the chillies. Remove some of the seeds if you would like a milder paste.

steps.title: Pulse
steps.text: Tip the chillies, vinegar, salt and sugar into the food processor. Pulse, scraping down the sides, until you have a coarse paste.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the lime juice, taste, and spoon into a clean jar.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve in small amounts with rice, noodles, fried eggs or grilled chicken, with lime wedges on the side.

tips: Pulse rather than blend: a coarse paste keeps the fresh chilli texture and does not turn watery.
Use a mix of mild and hot red chillies to control the heat.
A mortar and pestle gives a more rustic texture.
Leave for a day to let the flavours mellow.
safety: Wear gloves and do not touch your eyes while handling chillies.
storage: Keep in a clean jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
